component.name: Oxyfin
component.summary: Native client for Jellyfin media servers

description.p: Oxyfin is a native desktop client for Jellyfin. It signs in to your server, browses your movie and show libraries, searches them and plays your media with mpv, without any web view.

ul.li: Sign in with a password or Quick Connect
Home screen with Continue Watching, Next Up and recently added media
Movie and show libraries, search, movie and series pages
Playback through libmpv, with resume and progress sync

description.p: Oxyfin is in early development: expect missing features and bugs.
First release: sign in, browse and search the libraries, and play media.
